title: The Brother's Shadow
summary: Tae-Jun and Ha-Jun examine Malgath's memories, discovering the location of the Void Cult's headquarters and the horrifying truth of the tenth Mythic Relic: The Hourglass of Eternal Abyss.

panels.shot: mount obsidian grand council pavilion wide shot
panels.action: An open-air pavilion of black star-marble overlooking the 300,000 allied demons camped in the valley below.
panels.prose_en: An open-air pavilion of black star-marble overlooking the 300,000 allied demons camped in the valley below.
panels.prose_hi: Kale taare-sangmarmar ka ek khula mandap neeche ghati mein dera dale hue 300,000 sahyogi rakshason ko dekhta hai.

panels.shot: demon king malgath seated bandaged on giant stone block
panels.action: Malgath sits with his massive chest wrapped in clean white linens, drinking healing elixir with Tae-Jun.

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: Is healing elixir mein human herbs ki mehek hai... Bohot refreshing hai.

panels.prose_en: Malgath sits with his massive chest wrapped in clean white linens, drinking healing elixir with Tae-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath saaf safed linen mein apni vishal chhati ko lapete hue baitha hai, Tae-Jun ke saath upchar amrit pee raha hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun smiling as he refills malgath bowl
panels.action: Tae-Jun smiles: 'Human medicine aur demon mana ka combination har wound ko double speed se heal karta hai.'
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun smiles: 'Human medicine aur demon mana ka combination har wound ko double speed se heal karta hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun muskurate han: 'manav chikitsa aur danav man ka sanyojan har ghav ko doguni gati se theek karta hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun standing by balcony edge with crown
panels.action: Ha-Jun gazes out across the valley, fingers tracing the runes on the Eclipse Devourer.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun gazes out across the valley, fingers tracing the runes on the Eclipse Devourer.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ghati ki or dekhta hai, ungaliyan aclips davoorer par runon ka pata lagati han.

panels.shot: kuro perching on ha-jun shoulder
panels.action: Kuro tilts his head: 'Malgath ne apna army surrender kar diya. Lekin Valac aur Lilith abhi bhi hidden hain.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Woh dono Void Cult ke core members hain.

panels.prose_en: Kuro tilts his head: 'Malgath ne apna army surrender kar diya. Lekin Valac aur Lilith abhi bhi hidden hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apna sir jhukaya: 'Malgath ne apni sena ka aatmasamarpan kar diya. lekin valack aur lilith abhi bhi chhupe hue han.'

panels.shot: malgath setting down his bowl with a heavy clank
panels.action: Malgath speaks with deep gravity: 'Valac aur Lilith ne aakhri Mythic Relic ko seize kar liya hai.'

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: The Hourglass of Eternal Abyss... Unke possession mein hai.

panels.prose_en: Malgath speaks with deep gravity: 'Valac aur Lilith ne aakhri Mythic Relic ko seize kar liya hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath gahri gambhirta ke saath bolta hai: 'valack aur lilith ne aakhiri mithik avashesh ko jabt kar liya hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun turning sharply to face malgath
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes narrow: 'The Hourglass of Eternal Abyss... Wahi relic jo time ko manipulate karta hai?'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes narrow: 'The Hourglass of Eternal Abyss... Wahi relic jo time ko manipulate karta hai?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen sikud gain: 'd ovarglas off iternal abis... wahi avashesh jo samay ko herfer karta hai?'.

panels.shot: kuro feathers ruffling with genuine terror
panels.action: Kuro's voice trembles for the first time in the saga: 'Us relic ka price terrifying hai, Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Hourglass time ko reverse kar sakta hai... Lekin har minute rewind karne par user ki ek cherished memory permanently erase ho jaati hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's voice trembles for the first time in the saga: 'Us relic ka price terrifying hai, Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Gatha mein pehli baar Kuro ki awaaz kampati hai: 'us avashesh ka mulya bhayanak hai, Ha-Jun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun freezing at the revelation
panels.action: Ha-Jun's heart chills: 'Memory erasure...?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Agar maine time rewind kiya... Toh main apne bhai ko bhool sakta hoon?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's heart chills: 'Memory erasure...?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka dil thanda ho gaya: 'smriti mitana...?'.

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping up to ha-jun gripping his shoulders
panels.action: Tae-Jun grips Ha-Jun firmly: 'Isliye tum use kabhi use nahi karoge, Ha-Jun! Chahe kuch bhi ho jaye!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Main tumhe apne aap ko bhoolne nahi doonga! Samjhe?!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun grips Ha-Jun firmly: 'Isliye tum use kabhi use nahi karoge, Ha-Jun! Chahe kuch bhi ho jaye!'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne Ha-Jun ko majbuti se pakad liya: 'isliye tum kabhi use nahin karoge, Ha-Jun! chahe kuch bhi ho jaye!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking into tae-jun fierce loving eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun nods softly: 'Main promise karta hoon, Bhai. Main apni memories ko kabhi sacrifice nahi karunga.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun nods softly: 'Main promise karta hoon, Bhai. Main apni memories ko kabhi sacrifice nahi karunga.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne dheere se sir hilaya: 'main vaada karta hun, bhai. main apni yaadon ko kabhi balidan nahin dunga.'

panels.shot: malgath unfolding a black dimensional parchment map
panels.action: Malgath spreads an ancient star map across the stone table: 'The Chamber of Chronos.'
panels.prose_en: Malgath spreads an ancient star map across the stone table: 'The Chamber of Chronos.'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath ne patthar ki mej par ek prachin tara manchitra failaya: 'd chamber off cronos'.

panels.shot: map showing a rift at the boundary of reality
panels.action: At the outermost edge of the Demon Realm: a distorted whirlpool labelled 'THE EYE OF CHRONOS - TIME VOID'.

dialogue.text: Wahan time normal flow nahi karta... Boondein hawa mein freeze ho jaati hain.

panels.prose_en: At the outermost edge of the Demon Realm: a distorted whirlpool labelled 'THE EYE OF CHRONOS - TIME VOID'.
panels.prose_hi: Danav kshetra ke sabse bahari kinare par: ek vikrit bhanvar jise 'cronos ki aankh - samay shunya' kaha jata hai.

panels.shot: malgath explaining the enemy plan
panels.action: Malgath explains: 'Valac aur Lilith Hourglass ko use kar ke First Sovereign ke fall se pehle ka time rewind karna chahte hain.'

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: Taaki woh Void Primordial ko direct past mein summon kar sakein!

panels.prose_en: Malgath explains: 'Valac aur Lilith Hourglass ko use kar ke First Sovereign ke fall se pehle ka time rewind karna chahte hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath batate han: 'valack aur lilith ovarglas ko first Sovereign ke fall se pehle ka time rewind karna chahte han.'

panels.shot: ha-jun jaw tightening with furious resolve
panels.action: Ha-Jun slams his palm onto the table: 'Hum unhe time rewind karne nahi denge.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Past ko past mein rehna chahiye. Hum present mein ladenge.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slams his palm onto the table: 'Hum unhe time rewind karne nahi denge.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni hatheli mej par patak di: 'ham unhen time rewind nahin karne denge.'

panels.shot: kuro expanding into shadow flight form
panels.action: Kuro glides into the air: 'The Eye of Chronos 100 miles door hai. Humein abhi nikalna hoga!'
panels.prose_en: Kuro glides into the air: 'The Eye of Chronos 100 miles door hai. Humein abhi nikalna hoga!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro hawa mein udta hai: 'd aai off chronos 100 meal door hai. hamen abhi nikalna hoga!'.

panels.shot: malgath offering his elite iron vanguard
panels.action: Malgath stands: 'Mera 10,000 Flying Wyvern Corps tumhare sath chalega, My Sovereign!'

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: Woh Valac ke shadow wraiths ko distract karenge!

panels.prose_en: Malgath stands: 'Mera 10,000 Flying Wyvern Corps tumhare sath chalega, My Sovereign!'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath ka kehna hai: 'mera 10,000 flying wivern corps tumhare saath chalega, mai soweren!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun nodding with gratitude to malgath
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles: 'Thank you, King Malgath. Apne sky division ko deploy karo.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Wyvern Corps ko air cover par rakho.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles: 'Thank you, King Malgath. Apne sky division ko deploy karo.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun muskurata hai: 'dhanyavad, raja Malgath. apne sky division ko tainat karo.'

panels.shot: ten thousand armored flying wyverns taking to the sky
panels.action: Ten thousand massive winged reptilian beasts take flight from the valley, blotting out the twin moons.
panels.prose_en: Ten thousand massive winged reptilian beasts take flight from the valley, blotting out the twin moons.
panels.prose_hi: Das hajar vishal pankhon wale sarisrup janwar ghati se udaan bharte han, aur judwan chandramaon ko nasht kar dete han.

panels.shot: ha-jun unfurling his 12-foot shadow wings
panels.action: Ha-Jun's wings burst outward, crowned in royal obsidian ruby light.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's wings burst outward, crowned in royal obsidian ruby light.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ke pankh bahar ki or fute, shahi obsidian ruby prakash mein taj pehnaya gaya.

panels.shot: tae-jun leaping onto a royal wyvern beside him
panels.action: Tae-Jun vaults onto the saddle of an armored black royal wyvern, twin swords ready.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun vaults onto the saddle of an armored black royal wyvern, twin swords ready.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ek bakhtarband kale shahi vayavarn ki kathi par chadhta hai, judwan talwaren taiyar han.

panels.shot: ha-jun launching into supersonic flight alongside wyverns
panels.action: Ha-Jun rockets into the sky at Mach 1.5, leading the ten-thousand-strong armada toward the edge of time.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rockets into the sky at Mach 1.5, leading the ten-thousand-strong armada toward the edge of time.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne mac 1.5 par aakash mein rocket daage, jisse das hajar majboot armada samay ke ant ki or badh gaya.

panels.shot: crossing the threshold of the temporal anomaly
panels.action: The clouds ahead begin moving backward; lightning flashes rewind from the earth into the sky.
panels.prose_en: The clouds ahead begin moving backward; lightning flashes rewind from the earth into the sky.
panels.prose_hi: Aage ke badal peeche ki or badhne lagte han; bijli ki chamak prithvi se aakash ki or ghumti hai.

panels.shot: falling rain droplets freezing in midair
panels.action: Rain droplets stop falling, hovering motionless in the air like suspended crystal marbles.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Time yahan freeze ho raha hai... Hum Chronos ke territory mein enter kar chuke hain.

panels.prose_en: Rain droplets stop falling, hovering motionless in the air like suspended crystal marbles.
panels.prose_hi: Barish ki bunden girna band kar deti han, nilambit crystal marble ki tarah hawa mein gatiheen ho jaati han.

panels.shot: colossal floating temporal temple reveal
panels.action: Suspended inside a spinning vortex of clock hands and frozen starlight: The Temple of Chronos.
panels.prose_en: Suspended inside a spinning vortex of clock hands and frozen starlight: The Temple of Chronos.
panels.prose_hi: Ghadi ki suiyon aur jami hui taron ki roshni ke ghumte bhanwar ke andar nilambit: chronos ka mandir.

panels.shot: two demon lords waiting on the temple terrace
panels.action: Standing on the crystalline clock terrace: Demon Lord Valac (clothed in living shadows) and Queen Lilith.
panels.prose_en: Standing on the crystalline clock terrace: Demon Lord Valac (clothed in living shadows) and Queen Lilith.
panels.prose_hi: Cristliy ghadi ki chhat par khade: danav lord valack (jivit chhaya mein kapde pahane hue) aur rani lilith.

panels.shot: between them: the floating hourglass of eternal abyss
panels.action: Suspended above a golden pedestal: an ancient 3-foot Hourglass of obsidian and diamond sands flowing upward.

dialogue.text:
[TARGET LOCATED: HOURGLASS OF ETERNAL ABYSS (MYTHIC)]
Authority: Temporal Reversion & Chrono-Freezing
Warning: Sands are Flowing in Reverse.

panels.prose_en: Suspended above a golden pedestal: an ancient 3-foot Hourglass of obsidian and diamond sands flowing upward.
panels.prose_hi: Ek sunhare aasan ke upar latka hua: obsidian aur heere ki ret se bana ek prachin 3 foot ka ghantaghar jo upar ki or bah raha hai.

panels.shot: valac raising shadow scythe mockingly
panels.action: Lord Valac sneers: 'You are too late, boy! The Great Rewind has already begun!'

dialogue.speaker: valac
dialogue.text: TEN MINUTES MORE AND THIS WORLD WILL REVERT TO THE VOID AGE!!

panels.prose_en: Lord Valac sneers: 'You are too late, boy! The Great Rewind has already begun!'.
panels.prose_hi: Lord valack ne vyangya kiya: 'tum bahut der kar chuke ho, ladke! great rewind pehle hi shuru ho chuka hai!'

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing eclipse devourer and fang of abyss
panels.action: Ha-Jun dives from the sky, dual-wielding the Dark-Matter Greatsword and the Spatial Void Dagger.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun dives from the sky, dual-wielding the Dark-Matter Greatsword and the Spatial Void Dagger.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aasman se gota lagata hai, dark-mater gratusward aur spateal void dagar ko dohre roop mein istemaal karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun slamming onto the temple terrace like a thunderbolt
panels.action: Ha-Jun impacts the clockwork terrace between Valac and Lilith: 'Then I have ten minutes to cut you both in half.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun impacts the clockwork terrace between Valac and Lilith: 'Then I have ten minutes to cut you both in half.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun valack aur lilith ke beech ghadi ki kal ki chhat par prabhav dalta hai: 'tab mere paas aap donon ko aadha karne ke liye das minute han.'
